points_2d.description: The matching image points `[u, v]`, pixels.

points_3d.description: 3D points `[x, y, z]` in the target frame, metres.

FxFyCxCy.description:
Standard pinhole intrinsics: focal lengths and principal point in pixels.

The pixel grid is assumed orthogonal, so `K` carries no skew term.

cx.description: Principal point X coordinate in pixels.

cy.description: Principal point Y coordinate in pixels.

fx.description: Focal length in pixels along X.

fy.description: Focal length in pixels along Y.

HandeyeMeta.description:
Metadata for a single hand-eye view.

`base_se3_gripper` is the gripper pose expressed in the base frame (T_B_G).

base_se3_gripper.description: Gripper pose expressed in base frame (`T_B_G`) for this view.

Iso3Schema.description:
JSON Schema proxy for [`Iso3`] (`nalgebra::Isometry3<f64>`).

`nalgebra` does not implement [`schemars::JsonSchema`], so `*Export` and
parameter types that embed [`Iso3`] annotate the field with
`#[cfg_attr(feature = "schemars", schemars(with = "Iso3Schema"))]`
(or `Vec<Iso3Schema>` / `Option<Iso3Schema>`). This proxy mirrors the exact
serde wire format of `Isometry3`:
`{ "rotation": [qx, qy, qz, qw], "translation": [tx, ty, tz] }`.

It exists only to describe that shape to `schemars`; it is never
constructed at runtime.

rotation.description: Unit quaternion `[qx, qy, qz, qw]` (i, j, k, w order).

LaserPlane.description:
Laser plane in camera frame: unit normal + signed distance.

The plane equation is: n̂ · p + d = 0
where p is a point in camera coordinates.

normal.description: Unit normal vector in camera frame. Serializes as `[nx, ny, nz]`.

LaserlineMeta.description: Metadata for a laserline view (laser pixels + optional weights).

laser_weights.description: Per-pixel weights (empty = unweighted, all default to 1.0).

NoMeta.description: Empty metadata marker for views that do not need extra metadata.

id.description: Camera id from the dataset manifest.

PlanarDataset.description:
A planar dataset consisting of multiple views.

Each view observes a planar calibration target in pixel coordinates.

RigDataset.description: Multi-view dataset for a camera rig.

num_cameras.description: Number of cameras in the rig.

RigDataset2.description: Multi-view dataset for a camera rig.

num_cameras.description: Number of cameras in the rig.

RigHandeyeLaserlineInput.description: Input for joint rig hand-eye laserline calibration.

num_cameras.description: Number of cameras in the rig.

views.description: Per-view target observations, laser pixels, and robot poses.

obs.description:
Target corners + laser pixels per camera (same shape as
[`RigLaserlineView`]).

num_cameras.description: Number of cameras in the rig; governs the expected slot count per view.

views.description:
Per-view observation rows; length = number of views.

Each `RigLaserlineView` contains two `Vec`s of length `num_cameras`,
one for target correspondences and one for laser pixels.

RigLaserlineDeviceInput.description: Input for rig laserline calibration: dataset + frozen upstream calibration.

initial_planes_cam.description:
Optional per-camera initial plane in camera frame. If `None`, defaults
to a generic `z=-0.2m` plane.

RigLaserlineView.description:
Per-view observations for a rig-level laserline calibration.

Both `cameras` and `laser_pixels` are indexed by `cam_idx ∈ [0, num_cameras)`.
A slot is `None` when that camera had no usable data in this view (occlusion,
out-of-FOV, etc.).  An empty inner `Vec` is accepted but treated the same as
`None` by the solver.

cameras.description:
Target correspondences per camera (`cam_idx` → `Option<CorrespondenceView>`).

`None` means the camera did not see the calibration target in this view.
The slice length must equal `RigLaserlineDataset::num_cameras`.

laser_pixels.description:
Laser pixel observations per camera (`cam_idx` → `Option<Vec<Pt2>>`).

`None` means the camera has no usable laser data for this view.
The slice length must equal `RigLaserlineDataset::num_cameras`.

RigUpstreamCalibration.description:
Upstream rig calibration (frozen starting point).

Mirrors a Scheimpflug hand-eye result's per-camera intrinsics + distortion +
Scheimpflug sensors + cam→rig poses, plus the per-view rig→target poses the
downstream laserline dataset spans.

RigView.description: One time-synchronized rig frame containing per-camera observations and metadata.

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata payload associated with the view.

obs.description: Per-camera observations for this rig frame.

RigView2.description: One time-synchronized rig frame containing per-camera observations and metadata.

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata payload associated with the view.

obs.description: Per-camera observations for this rig frame.

RigViewObs.description: Multi-camera observations for one rig view/frame.

cameras.description: Per-camera observation; None if camera didn't observe in this view.

RobotPoseMeta.description: Per-view robot metadata required by hand-eye calibration.

base_se3_gripper.description: Gripper pose expressed in the robot base frame (T_B_G).

tilt_x.description: Tilt around X axis in radians (alias: tau_x).

tilt_y.description: Tilt around Y axis in radians (alias: tau_y).

View.description: Single-camera observation view with attached metadata.

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata payload associated with the view.

View2.description: Single-camera observation view with attached metadata.

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata payload associated with the view.

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata payload associated with the view.

description:
Image-free observations for one calibration problem.

Serialized flat: `{"version", "cameras", "problem", "input"}`, where
`problem` names the problem type and `input` is its input payload.

oneOf.description:
Planar intrinsics of one camera (any camera model; the entry's config
names the sensor).
One camera plus a laser plane.
Hand-eye calibration of a camera rig.
Per-camera laser planes on a calibrated rig.
Joint rig hand-eye and laser-plane calibration.

Format version; [`OBSERVATION_SET_VERSION`] for files this build
writes.
